title: Normalized tensor pullback: OpenSquare
statement: Let $A,B,C$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $j:A\to B$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], $b:B\to C$ a morphism, $V\subseteq C$ open, and $a:A\to V$ a morphism. Suppose $j(A)=b^{-1}(V)$ as opens and $b\circ j=V.\iota\circ a$. For every $\mathcal O_C$-module $G$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with tensor pullback $P$ [def-pc-module-pullback] and chosen canonical unit $\eta$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], there is an isomorphism $e:(P_bG)|_A\cong P_a(G|_V)$. On global sections, it sends the section $\eta_b(G)(t)$ over $b^{-1}V$, transported to the image $j(A)$, to the global $a$-unit section of $t$ regarded as a global section of $G|_V$ by transport along $V.\iota(\top)=V$. This holds for every $t\in\Gamma(V,G)$, including when V is empty. Restrictions are those of [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-module-pullback-restriction], and the top section is [def-sc-scalar-global-sections-comparison].

source.place: Tags 0096 (lemma-adjoint-pullback-pushforward-modules) and 0097 (lemma-push-pull-composition-modules); expanded canonical unit calculation, as used in Tag 0BED

proof.text: The composite adjunctions (restriction by V.ι followed by tensor pullback by a) and (tensor pullback by b followed by restriction by j) have right adjoints a_* followed by V.ι_* and j_* followed by b_*. Compose pushforwardComp a V.ι, pushforwardCongr h.symm and the inverse pushforwardComp j b to identify these right adjoints. Conjugate this isomorphism under the two composite adjunctions to construct the required left-adjoint comparison e.

Evaluate unit_conjugateEquiv_symm on G and the section t over V. The image equation gives j inverse-image of b inverse-image V equal to top. Use naturality of e to move the component to top; the restriction unit and that transport compose into exactly the map along the image equality. On the other side the right-adjoint comparison contributes an open-equality transport. Naturality of the a unit moves it before the unit. The V.ι restriction unit and the inverse-image-top transport compose into transport of t along V.ι(top)=V. The final top restriction in tensorPullbackTopSection is identity. All identities apply to empty opens.

proof_origin.place: Expanded and proved the unit calculation using Tags 0096 and 0097, read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0096 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0097.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_tensorPullback_openSquare {A B C : Scheme.{w}}
    (j : A ⟶ B) [IsOpenImmersion j] (b : B ⟶ C) (V : C.Opens)
    (a : A ⟶ V.toScheme) (hj : j ''ᵁ ⊤ = b ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (h : j ≫ b = a ≫ V.ι) (G : C.Modules) :
    ∃ e : ((tensorPullback b).obj G).restrict j ≅
        (tensorPullback a).obj (G.restrict V.ι),
      ∀ (t : Γ(G, V)),
        e.hom.app ⊤
          (((tensorPullback b).obj G).presheaf.map (eqToHom hj).op
            (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction b)).unit.app G).app V t)) =
          tensorPullbackTopSection a (G.restrict V.ι)
            (G.presheaf.map (eqToHom (by simp : V.ι ''ᵁ ⊤ = V)).op t)
